request.mechanism: categorySnapshot passes request.category through categoryName (String/trim only) and categoryScope concatenates it inside a quoted SQL predicate; the resulting scope is concatenated into the db.query SQL text. Unlike the fixed Serene-tagged queries, this value is not bound, so quote/comment/operators in the request can alter the WHERE clause.
request.impact: The inventoryReport route supplies untrusted query input to this function, allowing SQL syntax injection in the category filter and potentially changing returned rows or query behavior.
